author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 — now_utc_string returns UTCDate but the wire string (24-char YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ form with millis) does not pass UTCDate::new_validated (which requires 20-char no-millis form). The newtype invariant is silently violated; consumers that call .new_validated on the result fail.

Three sub-options: (a) tighten UTCDate::new_validated to accept the 24-char form, (b) introduce a separate UTCDateMs newtype, (c) document the divergence prominently and accept the asymmetry. Option (a) is a jmap-types crate change with workspace propagation. Defer to major-bump decision.
